profile.manufacturing_ethos: One of India's most trusted helmet brands, Vega has been producing ISI and DOT certified helmets for over four decades. Their expansive lineup ranges from budget commuter lids to feature-rich touring helmets, making quality head protection accessible to millions of Indian riders.
profile.helmet_types: Full Face, Open Face, Half, Motocross, Adventure
profile.story: Vega is an Italian motorcycle helmet manufacturer that was established in 1974 by the brothers Giancarlo and Giuseppe Vega in Bologna. Originally founded as a small workshop specializing in leather goods and accessories, the company pivoted to helmet manufacturing in response to growing safety concerns on Italian roads, quickly becoming one of the first European brands to prioritize advanced safety standards over mere style. Throughout the 1970s and 1980s, Vega gained a reputation for producing high-quality, aerodynamic helmets that offered superior protection compared to many contemporaries, helping to popularize the use of full-face designs in Europe.

brand_heritage_matrix.engineering_philosophy: Advanced Protective Shell Technology & Rider Ergonomic Comfort

qualitative_brand_identity.brand_reputation_summary: Vega is globally recognized for its commitment to rider safety, aerodynamic innovation, and precision helmet manufacturing.
qualitative_brand_identity.editorial_brand_verdict: With decades of motorsport heritage, Vega consistently produces helmets that exceed global safety standards (ECE 22.06, DOT, FIM) while maintaining rider comfort.
